project_context.theme: Light theme primary (Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast). Focused on extremely dense data tables, minimal decorative elements, and ultra-high legibility for administrators working long hours. Avoid dark mode unless user specifically toggles it, but light mode is default for spreadsheet-friendly apps.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' + 'Swiss' hybrid. Clean legibility for massive data grids, mono for financials.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl font-black tracking-tight (Do not exceed 3xl for internal dashboards)

typography.installation: Ensure fonts are imported via Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.

colors.strategy: Monochrome base with sharp semantic highlights. Content > Container.
colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.css CSS variables with these HSL values. Ensure semantic colors are mapped to Shadcn destructive, etc.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid. Utilize 100% of the screen. Avoid empty gutters. Sidebar navigation.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Extremely tight inside components (p-2, p-3), standard padding around main containers (p-6, p-8).

structure.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50. Collapses to drawer on mobile.
structure.topbar: h-14 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center px-6 bg-white sticky top-0 z-40.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. KPI cards span 1 column. Charts span 2-3 columns.
grids_and_layouts.table_layout: Full width, border-collapse. Scrollable x and y. Sticky headers.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). 1px sharp borders everywhere. 0px or 4px max border-radius.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-slate-200), NO box-shadow. Radius: rounded-sm (4px).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.tables: Row borders only (border-b border-slate-100). Hover state on rows: bg-slate-50. Headers: bg-slate-50 uppercase text-[11px].
surfaces_and_micro_themes.badges: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm), strong text/bg contrast for Safe/Low/Critical. No borders on badges.

motion.strategy: Utilitarian & Snappy. Interactions must feel instant to avoid slowing down data entry.
motion.tables: Hovering over a row should strictly highlight the row. Do not animate table cell contents.
motion.progress_bars: Smooth linear transitions for Stock Opname progress.

component_instructions.general: Heavily use Shadcn components but strip out the default 'Vercel' look (reduce border radius, remove box-shadows).
component_instructions.tables: MUST be dense. Reduce Shadcn default table cell padding from p-4 to px-3 py-2. Use text-sm for data, text-xs for headers.
component_instructions.buttons: Square or mildly rounded (rounded-sm). Action buttons must be dense (h-8 or h-9).
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn forms + React Hook Form. Inputs must have clear focus rings (ring-slate-900).
component_instructions.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a dense, highly legible dashboard aesthetic. Install via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn). Minimal grid lines, solid monochrome lines/bars for inventory movement. No gradients.
component_instructions.toast: Use sonner for notifications. Position: top-right.

specific_views.stock_opname: Requires a visual workflow (Draft -> In Progress -> Completed -> Finalized). Add a sticky bottom bar or top banner with the progress bar and save buttons.
specific_views.bulk_import: Requires a preview table before committing. Highlight invalid rows in light red.
specific_views.products_sku: SKU codes MUST be monospaced. Purchase price history shown in a nested table or slide-out sheet.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors pass APCA over their respective backgrounds, especially semantic badges.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, table rows, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='stock-in-submit', data-testid='sku-search-input').
accessibility.keyboard: Tables and bulk inputs must support tab-navigation efficiently.

media_and_images.strategy: Internal tools don't need decorative images. Only use a clean avatar for the logged-in user profile, and potentially a generic corporate logo in the sidebar if needed. No placeholders.

user_avatar.description: Professional minimal headshot for user profile dropdown

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align dense content.
Create depth through border hierarchy rather than shadows for this specific internal app.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use dense, sharp-edged button styles relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use Phosphor icons. Ensure crisp line weights.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All numbers/currency (Rp) MUST be right-aligned in tables.
Date format MUST be DD MMM YYYY.
